sloka: देशस्य पूजाम् ताम् दृष्ट्वा कृताम् शक्रेण धीमता ।एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ दीर्घ कालम् अरिन्दम ॥१-२४-२४॥
transliteration: deśasya pūjām tām dṛṣṭvā kṛtām śakreṇa dhīmatā ।etau janapadau sphītau dīrgha kālam arindama ॥1-24-24॥

translations.english: O Destroyers of enemies these prosperous townships, Malada and Karusha looked cheerful with (bumper) crops and wealth for a long time.
